# Emit OKF Markdown wiki pages from Knowledge IR

Converts the compiler's Knowledge IR (Entity and Relationship objects) into OKF-conformant Markdown files with YAML frontmatter, content bodies, relation sections, and a generated warning. It writes the generated files into a specified output directory.
